data.credibility: Management frequently drops or delays targets, particularly regarding major capex and project timelines. While they successfully commissioned MIBK, MIBC, and acetophenone in August, repeated revisions to project costs, timelines, and spending estimates highlight execution risks.

lines.line: Promised INR 3,000 to 4,000 crore capex; topic was dropped across subsequent quarters.
Guided INR 1,500 crore FY26 capex, was lowered and later dropped.
Expected INR 2,500 crore FY27 capex; dropped in subsequent quarters.
Targeted Q4 FY26 MIBK/MIBC commissioning; delayed and ultimately dropped.
Targeted December 2027 polycarbonate commissioning; delayed to June 2028.
Rescheduled MIBK and MIBC commissioning to Q2 FY27; slipped.
Expected polycarbonate commissioning by June 2028; slipped from prior timeline.
Expected FY27 capex of INR 1,500 to 1,600 crore; currently pending.
Stated INR 11,500 crore total capex for mega project; raised to INR 11,700 crore.
Guided peak debt of INR 8,000 to 8,500 crore; currently pending.
Targeted August commissioning for MIBK, MIBC, and acetophenone; delivered on schedule.
Guided INR 2,200 to 2,400 crore capex for FY28; currently pending.
Guided INR 2,500 crore capex for FY 2028-2029; currently pending.

bull: Deepak Nitrite holds a dominant domestic market share of over 50% in Phenol and Acetone.
The balance sheet remains lightly geared, with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.27 based on borrowings of INR 1,762 crore against net worth of INR 6,475 crore.
Operating cash flow conversion is strong at 88% of reported profit over the past 5 years.
bear: EBITDA margin has compressed significantly, dropping from 28.7% in FY21 to 12.5% in FY26, with TTM margin at 18.0%.
Net profit has declined at -6.6% per year over 5 years, and 3-year revenue growth has slowed to -0.4% annually.
Management exhibits weak execution credibility, frequently dropping or delaying large capital expenditure and mega project commissioning timelines.
